scope: Collections 1, 2, 3; 35 Hz recorded action deltas; no live cheat software is executed
window: 35 past action frames before ammo-decrement shot proxy; same weapon, pistol/shotgun/minigun; consecutive selected anchors at least 35 frames apart; no post-shot features
split: Unique hardware IDs hashed, sorted, shuffled once with fixed seed; floor 60% training, next to floor 80% calibration, remainder test. Device is not guaranteed person identity.
weighting: Equal total weight per training device; no test-driven tuning
threshold: Normal calibration windows only; smallest strict threshold with at most floor(n*0.01) alerts. No population false-positive guarantee.
interval: 300 fixed-model device cluster bootstrap replicates; descriptive 95% percentile interval, not retraining variability. Zero observed errors do not certify zero population error.
stress_scope: Predeclared sampling/missing-input sensitivity; not an adaptive attacker, no claim of adversarial robustness certification
sample_selection: First record in each true/false positive/negative bin per model, plus first of each auxiliary condition; diagnostic examples, not a representative sample
performance: Loaded CPU model, 1 library thread, 20 warmups, 200 single-window calls, 50 batch-64 calls. Feature/normalization included; no network, stream parsing, queuing or concurrent users
test_use: Public benchmark metadata and label distribution audited before training. Predictions and thresholds frozen before first test scoring. No tuning from held-out scores.
